nonBlockingObservations.summary: The final owning lane must rerun the archived native C sizeof(struct stat) probe and require equality with the 144-byte reference constant before using the independent CI-T28 primitive prices as evidence.

Unit acceptance still requires the complete corrected owning lane and all 24 final mutation variants on these pins, with explicit treatment of the unwaived 14-failure/7-ignored security baseline and candidate results.
